capabilities: toggle full width per note from a status-bar switch
store width state in the note's cssclasses property
toggle width via a command, ribbon, or context menus
preserve unrelated cssclasses values when toggling
support both editing view and reading view
extras: Full width is off by default and relies on Obsidian's default readable width; the plugin ships its own styling so no separate CSS snippet is needed.
problem: Obsidian's note width is controlled globally, so users who want some notes full width must edit cssclasses or CSS snippets by hand.
summary: Status-bar toggle that switches the active note between full width and readable width on a per-note basis via cssclasses.
